criteria.observableEvidence: Labels general unit-circle point (cos theta,sin theta) and transformed coordinates correctly, not merely one special angle.
Justifies cosine/sine reflection and odd-even identities by geometry for arbitrary valid theta.
Explicitly excludes tangent poles, handles angle units and verifies quadrant sign or counterexample.
Graphs or describes one-to-one restricted intervals and correct monotonicity for inverse sine, cosine and tangent.
Separates principal returned angle from all unrestricted solutions and justifies correct quadrant clue.
Classifies unique, multiple and contradictory location clues with clear domain and unit reasoning.
Uses original cofunction identity and inverse reference angle without introducing unsupported equivalent transformations.
Enumerates every root in the prescribed half-open or closed interval, including compressed-period case and endpoint exclusions.
Verifies all intersections with an accessible graph, table or approved numerical technology rather than one principal inverse result.
Separates first-party signal model from original publisher equation task, interprets seconds and physical operating range.
Constructs valid corresponding horizontal cross sections, names the same vertical height and correct units.
Derives A_H(z)=A_C(z)=pi(r^2-z^2) for every z in [0,r], not just sample heights.
Applies Cavalieri to cylinder-minus-correctly-oriented-cone and derives hemisphere and full sphere volumes.
Addresses unequal slices, equal-base-only fallacy and oblique versus right cylinder comparison with reasoning.
Builds or describes ellipse string-and-two-foci locus as constant SUM, verifying multiple candidate points.
Derives major/minor semiaxes and axes/translation using a>c and b^2=a^2-c^2, rejecting degenerate cases.
Separately derives hyperbola as constant absolute DIFFERENCE with c>a and checks both branches after squaring.
States that original 6.10H source covers ellipse while the hyperbola is first-party extension, not publisher-equivalent.
